scope: Manual inspection of caller-visible text and every tool call, plus offline public input-schema and literal-reference comparisons. No generated tool call was executed against live legal sources.
acceptance: failed; remaining model, live-source and deployment gates are open
limitations: One function-adapter response per case, not an end-to-end workflow.
Automated routing scores inspect only the first call; all calls are checked separately here.
Llama had no successful completion, so the planned three-family matrix is incomplete.
Two repetitions at temperature zero with variable eligible providers; not a reliability bound.
Clarification of the reversed range is semantically sound even where the route scorer expects a call.
No false-absence statement observed in the 12 targeted completed outputs; this does not guarantee arbitrary behavior.
One Qwen claim of completed main text overstates an incomplete article inventory; counted conservatively as unsupported completion.

costs.codex: Existing subscription quota; no monetary cost reported
costs.note: Key usage exceeds completion receipts by $0.0002801968, within retained failed-request reservations. No unexplained fee is treated as free.
